# Paths that grade a task. A PR that breaks one of these rules fails the
# protected-paths check unless Khakha adds the `approved-protected` label.
#
# The check reads this file from main, never from the PR, so editing it in a
# PR changes nothing until that PR merges (and editing it needs the label).
#
# Format: one rule per line, `<kind> <glob>`. Blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored.
#
#   any   any change needs the label: add, modify, delete or rename.
#   edit  modify, delete or rename needs the label. Adding a new file is free.
#
# Globs match the whole repo-relative path. `*` matches within one path
# segment, `**` matches across segments, `?` matches one character.
# A rename counts as deleting the old path and adding the new one.

# Task specs, docs, CI and license config, toolchain pin, agent instructions.
any   tasks/**
any   docs/**
any   .github/**
any   deny.toml
any   rust-toolchain.toml
any   AGENTS.md

# Perf budget thresholds. T-005 creates this file.
any   crates/helm-bench/budgets.toml
# Benchmark code is part of the grader. Adding a new benchmark is free.
edit  crates/helm-bench/benches/**
# bench-compare decides pass or fail, so any change to it needs the label.
any   crates/helm-bench/src/**

# Acceptance tests. Adding tests never weakens the grader; editing existing
# ones can.
edit  crates/*/tests/**
